title: Sub Zero – Ice Banana 100ml
description:
Sub Zero – Ice Banana 100ml
If you’re looking for an icy treat that’s packed with flavor, look no further than Subzero Banana Ice.
Looking for an iced e-liquid that will tantalize your tastebuds? Look no further than Subzero Banana Ice! This delicious new e-liquid from Subzero is bursting with authentic banana flavour, and has been perfectly finished with a refreshing ice kick.
Subzero has long been a leader in the Australian market for Malaysian-style iced e-liquids, and this new flavor is sure to keep them at the top of the game. With delicious fruits like berries, watermelons, grapes, strawberries, and now bananas covered, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.
Checkout other E-Liquid flavours from Sub Zero at
Sub Zero E-Liquids Collection.
Primary Flavours:
Banana, Menthol
Ratio:
70VG/30PG
Bottle Size:
100ml
Nicotine:
0mg
